BiblicalUsage: Kaleh is pining — the failing of the eyes with longing. In the curses of the covenant, Moses warns that a father's sons and daughters shall be given to another people, and his eyes shall look and fail with longing for them all the day long.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this verse is the saddest picture of exile: eyes that look and look and cannot bring back what was taken, and the longing itself becomes the punishment.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
